scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street view of a European-style building with a tree in front of it. The building has three stories and two balconies on the second floor. It is made of stone and has a beige color. There are windows on the first and second floors. The ground floor has large doors with graffiti on them. A person walks by the building. The street is paved with gray bricks and there is a black lamppost in the middle of the sidewalk. There is a chair on the right side of the street. The sky is overcast.
